options.name: comment
options.description: A descriptive comment of the Grid member.

options.name: config_addr_type
options.description: Address configuration type (IPV4/IPV6/BOTH).

options.name: create_token
options.description: Flag for initiating a create token request for pre-provisioned members.

options.name: enable_ha
options.description: If set to true, the member has two physical nodes (HA pair).

options.name: extattrs
options.description: Extensible attributes associated with the object.

options.name: external_syslog_server_enable
options.description: Determines if external syslog servers should be enabled.

options.name: host_name
options.description: Specifies the host name of the member to either add or remove from the NIOS instance. Users can also update the name as it is possible to pass a dict containing I(new_name), I(old_name). See examples.

options.name: ipv6_setting
options.description: Configures the IPv6 settings for the grid member.

options.name: lan2_enabled
options.description: When set to "true", the LAN2 port is enabled as an independent port or as a port for failover purposes.

options.name: lan2_port_setting
options.description: Settings for the Grid member LAN2 port if 'lan2_enabled' is set to "true".

options.name: master_candidate
options.description: Configures the instance of this object to be enabled as a Grid Master Candidate or a regular member node. true enables the member as a Master Candidate

options.name: mgmt_port_setting
options.description: Settings for the member MGMT port.

options.name: node_info
options.description: Configures the node information list with detailed status report on the operations of the Grid Member.

options.name: platform
options.description: Configures the Hardware Platform.

options.name: pre_provisioning
options.description: Pre-provisioning information.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: router_id
options.description: Virtual router identifier. Provide this ID if "ha_enabled" is set to "true". This is a unique VRID number (from 1 to 255) for the local subnet.

options.name: state
options.description: Configures the intended state of the instance of the object on the NIOS server.  When this value is set to C(present), the object is configured on the device and when this value is set to C(absent) the value is removed (if necessary) from the device.

options.name: syslog_servers
options.description: The list of external syslog servers.

options.name: upgrade_group
options.description: The name of the upgrade group to which this Grid member belongs.

options.name: use_syslog_proxy_setting
options.description: Use flag for external_syslog_server_enable , syslog_servers, syslog_proxy_setting, syslog_size.

options.name: vip_setting
options.description: Configures the network settings for the grid member.
